mines.mine_notes: Flagship silver development project near Mudgee, NSW. Conventional open-pit mining and processing (2.0 Mtpa plant, 16.5-yr life); simplified flowsheet producing a single high-grade precious-metal bulk concentrate (improved Ag payability/recovery; no cyanide); dry-stack tailings (world's best practice). Ore Reserve 32.8 Mt for 71.7 Moz Ag (28.1 Mt in Optimisation); M&I Resource 164 Moz Ag. Production schedule: avg 4.2-4.25 Mozpa first 10 yrs @ ~83 g/t Ag; LOM avg 2.7 Mozpa @ 53 g/t; LOM total ~72 Moz silver (plus minor Zn/Pb credits). >85% of revenue from silver. Permitting activities ongoing. Exploration upside: mineralised system open beneath pit design (e.g. 58 m @ 121 g/t Ag from surface; 18.3 m @ 443 g/t AgEq); potential high-grade underground option; bulk-sample grades averaged 43% above block model. Company Secretary Trent Franklin; silvermines.com.au.
